unreliable_reasons: wrapped phase step >= pi/2 between 3 adjacent point pair(s), max 2.721 rad

radiated_group_delay.model: Radiated group delay (only with 11 points): H(f) = E_far(theta=0, phi=0, f) exp(+j k r) / a_inc(f), with a_inc the incident-wave voltage at the reference plane of the port (same plane as S11: launch plane for MSL edge ports, the lumped port itself for the vertical probe port: no plane shift, no beta), r = 1 m, k = 2 pi f / c0. E_theta and E_phi of the phi=0 cut are the x and y components at broadside (theta_hat = x_hat, phi_hat = y_hat at phi = 0). tau_g = -d arg(H)/d omega from the unwrapped phase with central differences (one-sided at the ends). The excitation spectrum and its phase cancel; the NF2FF phase centre only adds a constant (z of the centre / c0 at broadside). The absolute value contains the constant electrical length of the line and of the stub; only the variation over the band (ripple) is meaningful. DIAGNOSTIC: not validated against a reference; 49.92 MHz spacing is below the DTFT resolution 1/T_record of the run, so adjacent samples are not independent.
radiated_group_delay.reliability_criterion: phase-unwrap reliability (round 12): a component is RELIABLE only if every wrapped phase step between adjacent frequency points is < pi/2 (1.5708 rad; the unwrap is unambiguous only below pi, pi/2 leaves a factor 2 margin; with 49.92 MHz spacing that is a residual delay < 5 ns) AND |H| >= -20 dB re its maximum over the points (a broadside null makes the phase jump by ~pi and the delay meaningless). Otherwise the component is UNRELIABLE and its delay values/ripple must not be used. The CSV columns reliable_* repeat the test per point (1 = both adjacent steps < pi/2 and |H| above the floor). Ripple (max - min of tau_g over the channel) is DIAGNOSTIC only: 11 correlated samples, one-sided end points, not validated.

model: openEMS.CreateNF2FFBox(frequency=[...]) (openEMS.pyx lines 464-521; frequency kw selects frequency-domain E/H dumps, nf2ff.py lines 65-80, dump_type 10/11, single-sided DFT weights Common/processfields_fd.cpp lines 103-106, the same single-sided convention as the port probes DFT_time2freq utilities.py lines 27-41, so Prad and port powers are directly comparable as in Tutorials/Helical_Antenna.py line 179 and RadarUWBTutorial.py line 182). Box = the default derived from the PML_8 boundaries: faces on mesh line index 9 / -10 (one cell inside the PML region, in air, outside the board and the substrate; no conductor crosses the box because the SMA/port is inside the board). CalcNF2FF(sim_path, freq, theta, phi, radius=1 m, center in METRES, read_cached=False): E_theta/E_phi include the factor exp(-jkr)/r at r = 1 m (nf2ff_calc.cpp lines 503-513), P_rad = |E|^2/(2 Z0) in W/m^2, Prad = net Poynting flux through the box (nf2ff_calc.cpp line 414, independent of the sampled angles), Dmax = max over the SAMPLED directions only (line 525). Quantities derived here: D = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / Prad; gain (IEEE, excludes mismatch) = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / P_acc; realised gain = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / P_inc (the formula of RadarUWBTutorial.py line 182, Dmax*Prad/P_inc); radiation efficiency = Prad / P_acc with P_acc = 0.5 Re(U I*) at the port reference plane (Helical_Antenna.py line 179; MSL edge ports since round 7: measurement plane, fixed 50 ohm, so the ~4.9 mm of feed line before it is outside the efficiency); total efficiency = Prad / P_inc. Prad contains radiation only; conductor, dielectric and any feed-stub loss are in P_acc - Prad. Vertical lumped ports (probe feed, round 12): P_inc and P_acc come from openEMS Port.CalcPort at the port (reference = the 50 ohm port resistance, no plane shift), so the probe is part of the antenna; same NF2FF box, same single-sided DFT convention.
E_field_convention: E at r = 1 m including exp(-jkr)/r; e^{+j omega t}-style DFT as in openEMS (single-sided); theta_hat=x_hat at theta=0,phi=0
power_reference: P_inc = |a|^2/(2 R), P_acc = 0.5 Re(U I*) of the 50 ohm vertical lumped port (openEMS Port.CalcPort, reference = port resistance 50 ohm); S11, efficiencies, gain, realised gain and the group-delay a_inc (incident wave voltage 0.5 (U + R I)) all refer to the lumped port itself: no plane shift, no beta, no de-embedding
